Name: Commercial Support Dataset Identifier
Description: This TRE provides basic information that describes the data contained in commercial imagery products that are provided in NITF format.

DAY.Name: Day of Dataset Collection
DAY.Description: This field contains the 'day of start' of Dataset Collection (Image Start Time). For any datasets containing imagery collected at different times, this will be the day of the earliest image included.

MONTH.Name: Month of Dataset Collection
MONTH.Description: This field contains the 'month of start' of Dataset Collection (Image Start Time). For any datasets containing imagery collected at different times, this will be the month of the earliest image included.

YEAR.Name: Year of Dataset Collection
YEAR.Description: This field contains the four-digit 'year of start' of Dataset Collection (Image Start Time). For any datasets containing imagery collected at different times, this will be the year of the earliest image included.

PLATFORM_CODE.Name: Platform Identification
PLATFORM_CODE.Description: This field contains the source satellite platform code.

VEHICLE_ID.Name: Vehicle Number
VEHICLE_ID.Description: This field contains the vehicle number of the source satellite.

PASS.Name: Pass Number
PASS.Description: This field contains the number of the satellite pass.

OPERATION.Name: Operation Number
OPERATION.Description: This field contains the number of the operation.

SENSOR_ID.Name: Sensor ID
SENSOR_ID.Description: This field identifies the type of payload data collection.

PRODUCT_ID.Name: Product ID
PRODUCT_ID.Description: This field identifies the broad class of commercial products. Table 2.1-7 in STDI-0006 v2.1 contains the Image Product Types.

RESERVED_1.Name: Reserved 1
RESERVED_1.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

TIME.Name: Image Start Time
TIME.Description: This field has the same time (UTC) defined in the NITF Image Segment Subheader, IDATIM field. This corresponds to ACQUISITION_DATE in STDI-0002 STDIDC Appendix D.1. For any datasets containing imagery collected at different times, this will be the time of the earliest image included.

PROCESS_TIME.Name: Process Completion Time
PROCESS_TIME.Description: This field defines the time (UTC) of NITF file creation. This is the same time defined in the NITF File Header, FDT field.

RESERVED_2.Name: Reserved 2
RESERVED_2.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

RESERVED_3.Name: Reserved 3
RESERVED_3.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

RESERVED_4.Name: Reserved 4
RESERVED_4.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

RESERVED_5.Name: Reserved 5
RESERVED_5.Description: This field is reserved for use in the future.

SOFTWARE_VERSION_NUMBER.Name: Software Version Number
SOFTWARE_VERSION_NUMBER.Description: This field contains the Software version used. The value is vendor-defined.
